name: uniformdev
description: Build with Uniform: framework integrations, experience modeling, Mesh, assets, and the Uniform MCP server.

uniform_project_id.title: Uniform project ID
uniform_project_id.description: Optional — needed only for the Uniform MCP server, not for the skills. Found in your Uniform project settings, or via `Copy as mcp json` in the dashboard. You can add it later with `/plugin configure`.

uniform_api_key.title: Uniform API key
uniform_api_key.description: Optional — needed only for the Uniform MCP server, not for the skills. A Service Account key or Personal Access Token with the Developer role on the project. You can add it later with `/plugin configure`.

uniform_ai_host.title: Uniform AI host
uniform_ai_host.description: Region-specific MCP host. Leave the default unless your team is in another region.
